ETH.note: Document states nothing on rules or authority over AI harms.
The AI is a health sector tool, not general administration.

facts.fact: IDinsight says HEP Assist, built by Last Mile Health with Ethiopia's Ministry of Health, is launched in five regions and operating, with call agents using an LLM assistant to answer health extension workers' clinical queries.

IDinsight reports that 19 Ministry of Health experts rated 91.2% of HEP Assist responses above average across 580 questions, and an endline survey as of 2025 found 83.3% medical accuracy in real-world use.
